sections.appearance: Iroha has really bushy, messy and wavy, waist-length red-purplish hair with bangs that frame her face and dull indigo colored eyes with vertical slit pupils. Halo ==== Iroha's halo is an indigo-blue/sky-blue circle with four evenly spaced spikes and a rhombus at the top that extends through the circle. Uniform ==== Iroha wears a slightly unbuttoned dark dress shirt paired with a loose red tie and a black straight mini-skirt. She completes her outfit with a black military coat featuring a red band below the shoulder and a fully red interior. Atop her head she wears a black military cap with a golden emblem on it. Her dark purple boots are ankle-length with black laces. According to her Memorial Lobby art, she may wear black socks underneath her boots. Firearm ==== She uses a black Walther P38K pistol with brown grips and a gold barrel. For her tank support, she commands an early model Pzkpfw. VI Tiger I Ausf. E heavy tank.

sections.personality: Although she's naturally lazy and prefers playing whenever given the opportunity, Iroha takes most of the responsiblities when it comes to cleaning up all the accidents Makoto left behind. Compared to Makoto, or even most of the Gehenna students, Iroha doesn't hate Gehenna's opposing academy, Trinity, as much as she mostly cares for her activities and Ibuki, the other member of Pandemonium Society.
